name: superflow
description: A portable full-flow dev toolkit: process skills (TDD, brainstorming, systematic-debugging, plans, code-review, verification, worktrees) woven with six routed specialist personas (sherlock, bossbaby, architect, designer, codezilla, bughunter), deterministic workflows for the expensive calls (multi-voice council, adversarial review sweep), a mock-locked design loop, and a self-scanning codebase rulebook so it fits any repo.
